objective: Select an actually usable Logistics Centre for a new shipment while respecting requested targets and existing handler eligibility.
source_observation: Old _advance_request chose first accessible centre with positive requested target. Dispatch handling requires actual matching duty, no pending reassignment, Idle phase, positive health and no stock/weapon carry. Requested count is not an eligible handler.
implementation: New Dispatch ready_dispatch_site collects accessible requested candidates in configured order, returns immediately if none, reads each current rear actor person-status at most once and retains only ephemeral ready-duty facts. Shared pure predicate preserves original worker conditions and short-circuit order. New request selection calls this once; existing accepted-manifest branch and all admissions/owners remain unchanged.
feasibility: Source: each F07 costs150 M11/200 builder-work seconds; two need300 of approved500 M11. Ordinary eight-worker purchase costs140 and supplies two haulers/four builders during construction; after completion seven normal hauling assignments plus one later-centre handler leave first-centre requested1 unfilled. Existing current geometry supports both placement positions. Fixed2400 construction/1200 reporting simulated ceilings and45s GitHub process limit; no rate/deadline growth.
direct_input: One ephemeral manually supplied new-code script retained in ignored logs/logistics-centre-selection/direct_input.gd; no committed regression fixture or old checker run.
limits: Direct selector evidence, when executed, does not establish _advance_request manifest acceptance, cargo movement, cancelled/returning manifests, first/repeat useful delivery, genuine automatic Army need, full #91/#83/#92, visible/native input,1x pacing or60FPS.
manual_steps: In an ordinary base with two built Logistics Centres, leave an earlier centre's requested handler unfilled through actual labour priorities while a later accessible centre has an idle on-duty handler. A new shipment should use the usable centre when its other real goods/truck/crew/route requirements permit.

A centre with target0 is not permission for new selection. When none has an eligible idle on-duty handler, inspect reporting/carry/reassignment work instead of treating requested staff as already available.
An already accepted shipment keeps its original captured centre and safe physical work even if another centre later becomes usable; the fix never relocates it.
reviews: Lead technical and designated Designer approval required at exact published head; no self-merge.
